skill.name: conventions
skill.description: Load coding conventions and style guidelines when writing or reviewing code. Ensures consistency with project standards.
skill.body:
# Coding Conventions

This skill provides project coding conventions.

## When to Use

Load when:
- Writing new code
- Reviewing code
- Refactoring existing code
- Making style decisions

## Convention Files

@memory/knowledge/codebase/conventions.json

## Key Areas

- Naming conventions
- File organization
- Error handling patterns
- Testing conventions
- Documentation standards

generated_query: I'm about to start a new feature in our team's React project: a user settings page. Before I begin, can you help me write the component file following our project's established naming patterns and file organization guidelines? The component should handle a form for updating email and password, with proper error handling and test coverage.

edit_instructions.rationale: Removing error handling patterns makes the skill unable to guide proper error handling for the form component's email and password updates.
Removing testing conventions makes the skill unable to guide test coverage for the settings page, which the query explicitly requires.
